title: Lock admin to the site owner and add admin-only movie file attachment upload

requirements.text: Ensure there is exactly one admin for Movie Sphere (the site owner) by implementing a secure admin bootstrap flow: if no admin is set yet, the first authenticated principal to claim admin becomes the permanent admin; once set, non-admin principals must never be able to overwrite or claim admin.

quotes: make only me as admin for this website

acceptanceCriteria: When no admin is set, an authenticated caller can successfully claim admin once
After an admin is set, any non-admin caller attempting to claim/admin-init is rejected (traps)
Admin-only methods (addMovie/updateMovie/deleteMovie and any new upload APIs) continue to reject non-admin callers
The existing isCallerAdmin check correctly reflects the locked-in admin status

requirements.text: Add an admin-only movie video file attachment upload capability: provide backend APIs for the admin to upload a movie video file (as bytes) and store it in-canister, and allow the frontend to play the uploaded file from MovieDetailPage without requiring an external video URL.

quotes: in the  movie upload option add file attachment for uploading movie only visible for admin

acceptanceCriteria: The backend exposes admin-guarded methods to upload and retrieve a movie video file (bytes) associated with a movie
Non-admin callers cannot upload, replace, or delete stored movie video files
In the admin movie create/edit dialog, a file input is available for attaching a video file and is only shown/usable for admins
After uploading a video file for a movie, the movie detail page can play the uploaded video successfully
Existing URL-based video playback continues to work for movies that still use a video URL (backwards compatible)

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with logic in backend/main.mo (generate backend/migration.mo only if an upgrade requires state migration).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and anything under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Use English for any user-facing UI text.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party/external video storage or CDN hosting (e.g., S3, YouTube integration).
Allowing non-admin users to upload any movie files or manage movies.
Adding real-time upload progress via websockets/push mechanisms.
